scenarioSurface.scenarioName: Bind submitted human review testimony to the exact review boundary

input.text: one projected blueprint bundle, its projection receipt, and submitted designated-reviewer testimony

event.text: the review boundary and testimony are admitted, the disposition is bound, and digest closure is verified

outcome.text: one review receipt carries the reviewer authority, every reviewed surface digest, and an approve, hold, or reject disposition, without admitting the capability

scenarioSurface.notes:
Before capability authority is admitted for collapse, a designated human must
  receive the deterministic projections and return approve, hold, or reject
  testimony. Designated human blueprint approval is a permanent, universal
  admission obligation, not a temporary assurance profile.

  The human decision occurs at the SideFX experience boundary. The provisioning
  circuit must durably pause after it publishes the exact review boundary and may
  resume only after the designated reviewer supplies testimony against that
  boundary. This capability does not simulate or invoke a human provider. It
  consumes the submitted testimony and deterministically validates, binds, and
  receipts it.

  Neither the person nor the interface self-admits the capability. An APPROVE
  receipt satisfies only the design-review obligation consumed by deterministic
  admission alongside contract, identity, lineage, closure, and proof gates. A
  HOLD or REJECT is valid review testimony and also receives a digest-bound
  receipt; it does not become a malformed-request failure.

schema.title: canonical-blueprint-review-binding-request.v2
schema.description: Carries exact blueprint, projection-receipt, and review-boundary bytes plus the submitted designated-human testimony. The capability recomputes byte digests, parses JSON without exception, validates cross-carrier closure, and binds testimony; it does not invoke a human or admit the reviewed capability.

projectionReceipt.description: Digest-bound authority reference for projectionReceiptBytesBase64; the runtime recomputes and compares the exact UTF-8 byte digest before reading receipt fields.

schema.title: canonical-blueprint-review-receipt.v2
schema.description: Binds designated-human testimony to recomputed blueprint, projection-receipt, and review-boundary byte digests. It satisfies only the review obligation; current-authority comparison and admission remain downstream deterministic gates.

reviewer.$comment: Reference to designated reviewer authority. Identity is referenced, never inlined as personal data.

reviewedSources.$comment: Exactly what the reviewer received. ASCII and Mermaid are always required; every required review view is bound alongside them.

projectionReceiptDigest.$comment: The projection receipt that produced the reviewed sources.

findings.$comment: Required for HOLD and REJECT. Exact findings, never a summary adjective.

subject.$comment: The blueprint node, edge, set, view, or field the finding is against.

rationaleReference.$comment: Reviewer rationale held as external authority rather than inlined prose.

allOf.$comment: A hold or reject without exact findings is not review testimony.
